name: video-art
description: Turn a folder of photos, clips and notes into a finished film with Claude Code: a wizard that analyses your material, asks about length, theme, style and voice, then animates your photos, scores, beat-cuts, grades, titles and mixes. Also narrated explainers, photo stories and generative loops.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: One key for image models (Gemini, GPT Image) and video models (Seedance, Veo, Kling). openrouter.ai/keys. Leave blank if OPENROUTER_API_KEY is already in your shell.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: For narration (Gemini TTS). aistudio.google.com/apikey. Leave blank if GEMINI_API_KEY is already set.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key (optional, paid plan)
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Alternative music engine (music API needs a paid ElevenLabs plan). Music works without it via Lyria on OpenRouter. Leave blank if unused or already set as ELEVEN_API / ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.
